description: This file provides utility functions for hashing strings and dictionaries, supporting 'md5' and 'sha256' algorithms, and integrates with Flask app configuration.

methods.name: get_hash_algorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the configured hash algorithm ('md5' or 'sha256') from the Flask app configuration.

methods.name: hash_from_str
methods.description: Generates a hash digest from a string using the specified or configured hash algorithm.

methods.name: hash_from_dict
methods.description: Generates a hash digest from a dictionary by serializing it to JSON and then hashing.
